# Scraper API — Live Service Documentation

> This documents a LIVE deployed scraper service on Netlify. Use these exact endpoints, tokens, and IDs.

## Service endpoints (LIVE)

### Function URL (sync scraping — up to 25s)
```
https://6a7fba0ba3bffe9e51e12005--transcendent-cheesecake-03f934.netlify.app/api/scrape
```

### Authentication (REQUIRED)
All requests to `/api/scrape` must include:
```
Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_NETLIFY_PAT>
```

### Blob store (read results — requires same PAT)
```
Site ID: 01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe
Store:   scraper-results (in API: site:scraper-results)
```

## Quick start — submit a scrape

```bash
curl -X POST \
  'https://6a7fba0ba3bffe9e51e12005--transcendent-cheesecake-03f934.netlify.app/api/scrape' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_NETLIFY_PAT>' \
  -d '{
    "jobs": [
      {"url": "https://example.com", "engine": "fetch"},
      {"url": "https://tls.peet.ws/api/all", "engine": "chrome_impersonate"}
    ],
    "result_mode": "blob"
  }'
```

Response:
```json
{
  "batch_id": "batch-1786755523361-btfjt0",
  "status": "complete",
  "succeeded": 2,
  "failed": 0,
  "elapsed_ms": 591,
  "results": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "ok": true,
      "status": 200,
      "url": "https://example.com",
      "engine": "fetch",
      "size": 559,
      "blob_key": "result/batch-1786755523361-btfjt0-0"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Read the scraped result (blob retrieval)

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_NETLIFY_PAT>" \
  'https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/blobs/01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe/site:scraper-results/result/batch-1786755523361-btfjt0-0'
```

Returns: raw bytes of the scraped response body.

## Check batch status (without calling the function — free)

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_NETLIFY_PAT>" \
  'https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/blobs/01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe/site:scraper-results/status/batch-1786755523361-btfjt0'
```

## List all batches

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_NETLIFY_PAT>" \
  'https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/blobs/01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe/site:scraper-results?prefix=status/'
```

## List all result blobs

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_NETLIFY_PAT>" \
  'https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/blobs/01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe/site:scraper-results?prefix=result/'
```

## Submit to queue (for long-running / puppeteer jobs)

```bash
curl -X POST \
  'https://6a7fba0ba3bffe9e51e12005--transcendent-cheesecake-03f934.netlify.app/api/scrape' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_NETLIFY_PAT>' \
  -d '{
    "jobs": [
      {"url": "https://example.com", "engine": "puppeteer", "wait_for": {"type": "timeout", "ms": 2000}, "screenshot": true}
    ],
    "queue": true,
    "result_mode": "blob"
  }'
```

Response (HTTP 202):
```json
{"batch_id": "batch-xxx", "status": "pending", "job_count": 1}
```

Queue is processed when a build runs. To trigger a build:
```bash
cd /path/to/netlify-project
netlify deploy --message "process queue"
```

## Job spec

```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "method": "GET",
  "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer xxx"},
  "body": null,
  "engine": "fetch",
  "timeout_ms": 25000,
  "follow_redirects": true,
  "user_agent": "Mozilla/5.0 ...",
  "wait_for": null,
  "actions": [],
  "screenshot": false,
  "screenshot_full": false
}
```

## Engines

| Engine | Sync | Queue | JA3 | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fetch` | ✅ | ✅ | Node fingerprint | Fast, all methods |
| `chrome_impersonate` | ✅ GET/HEAD | ✅ GET/HEAD | Chrome-like | Requires HTTPS |
| `puppeteer` | ❌ | ✅ | Real Chrome | Supports wait_for, actions, screenshot |

## Result modes

| Mode | Behavior | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| `blob` (default) | Stores body in blob, returns `blob_key` | 0 credits |
| `inline` | Returns body in response (≤32KB) | bandwidth |
| `metadata` | Discards body, returns headers only | ~0 |
| `auto` | Inline if ≤32KB, blob if larger | mixed |

## Validation

- URL must be http/https, no private IPs, no localhost
- `chrome_impersonate` requires `https://`
- `timeout_ms`: positive integer, max 25000 (sync) / 60000 (queue)
- `concurrency`: positive integer, max 5 (sync) / 10 (queue)
- `delay_ms`: non-negative integer, max 60000
- Max jobs: 50 (sync) / 500 (queue)

## Secrets for THIS deployment

```
API endpoint:    https://6a7fba0ba3bffe9e51e12005--transcendent-cheesecake-03f934.netlify.app/api/scrape
Auth token:      <YOUR_NETLIFY_PAT>
Site ID:         01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe
Blob store:      scraper-results (API path: site:scraper-results)
Blob API base:   https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/blobs/01c2e47f-3ff6-4e09-b45f-604c49ef90fe/site:scraper-results
```

## Netlify CLI (only needed for deploys + logs, NOT for blob reads)

```bash
# Install
npm install -g netlify-cli

# Read function logs (free, 24h retention)
netlify logs --json --since 1h

# Deploy (triggers build + queue processing)
netlify deploy --message "deploy"
```
